children: BP PLC Sponsored ADR (LSE:BP.) completed the sale of a 65% stake in Castrol to Stonepeak, retaining 35% in a joint venture, and expects to use about $6 billion in after-tax proceeds to cut debt. BP also raised its 2026 divestment and other proceeds target by $1 billion to about $9 billion.
Castrol Sale Proceeds To Cut Debt
: BP completed the sale of a 65% stake in Castrol to Stonepeak, retaining 35% in a new joint venture. It expects to use about $6 billion in after-tax proceeds to cut debt.
: BP raised its 2026 divestment and other proceeds target by $1 billion to about $9 billion, with proceeds expected to strengthen its balance sheet.

: BP said it offered to meet next week with United Steelworkers Local 7-1 over contract negotiations at its Whiting refinery, submitting revised terms and remaining open to talks or federal mediation.
: BP is in early talks with Reliance Industries and ONGC on a proposed $1 billion offshore facility in India’s Mahanadi basin to process and transport gas and condensate.
: BP appointed former Shell chemicals executive Emma Lewis to lead its downstream business, beginning Jan. 4, 2027. Richard Harding will remain interim head until then.
: BofA raised BP’s price target to 535 GBp from 525 GBp, keeping its Underperform rating. It sees limited upside to Q4 estimates and expects buybacks to resume in 2028.
: - Evercore ISI maintained its In-Line rating on BP PLC Sponsored ADR (BP.) and raised its price target to $55 from $52.
